title: Chimerify Addon: Alex's Mobs
description: Adds Alex's Mobs creature support to Chimerify.
body:
# **Chimerify Addon: Alex's Mobs**

Chimerify Addon: Alex's Mobs adds support for creatures from Alex's Mobs in the Chimerify ecosystem.

## Important

- Requires [Chimerify](https://modrinth.com/mod/chimerify)
- Requires [Chimerify Core](https://modrinth.com/mod/chimerify-core)
- Requires [Alex's Mobs](https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-mobs)

## Notes

- This project is under active development
- Supported content may expand over time
